e: Borrowed from Chinese 鴆鳥 /鸩鸟 (zhènniǎo)
From the surname of Yury Zhemchuzhnikov, Russian clay mineralogist, + -ite.
From Pitman zee, which it resembles phonetically and graphically, and the sound it represents.

q: The dinosaurs arriving from Asia proved the hardiest immigrants, though zhelestids (primitive insect-eating mammals that resembled elephant shrews) also somehow made it.
